reason: Executable auth/login/JWT/downstream principal contracts relevant to new ops login/session endpoints.
API envelopes and auth-related HTTP/code matrix for new endpoints and frontend integration.
Frontend HTTP client must centralize auth token injection and 401/403 handling.
Session state belongs in an auth store/composable boundary, not scattered through pages.
Composable boundaries for auth/session lifecycle, loading/error/retry, and cleanup.
New auth DTOs and frontend state must stay typed and contract-aligned.
This is a frontend + gateway + user-service + internal ops cross-layer auth flow.
